I answered Hollis in a thread on their message in #central-team. I checked first that Hollis is a member of the channel.

- **What was said:** On 14 October, Pree posted in #central-team that the deadline for Tansley Parcel's signed order form is 25 August.
- **Still unsettled:** 25 August 2026 had already passed when Pree posted, so I asked whether they meant 25 August 2027 or another date. Pree hasn't replied yet, so I told Hollis to check with Pree before putting it in the account sheet.
- **Sharing:** A signing deadline counts as an operational fact under the rules, and it was already posted in a channel Hollis is in. So I could share it.

My closing summary from the 14 October request also appears as its own message in #central-team (ts 1792159200.000125 is not it — it's 1791986400.000125). It was meant only for you, but it repeats what I'd already said in the thread.
